remarks: Highly sought-after residence in a full-service lifestyle community featuring an in-ground swimming pool, on-site fitness center, and professional property management. This beautifully updated unit offers a modern kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, complemented by luxury vinyl tile flooring in the main living areas, ceramic tile in the kitchen, and carpeting in the bedroom. A spacious wardrobe closet and extended hallway provide exceptional storage rarely found in similar units. Included with the home are one reserved parking space and one guest parking permit. Heat, hot water, and cooking gas are included in the rent-delivering outstanding value. Ideally located near downtown, Metro-North, and premier shopping, dining, and entertainment. Properties in this building lease quickly. Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply promptly. Refundable $500 building deposit required. Minimum credit score of 700 required. Available February 2nd.
